description: This Java source file defines the CatalogUrlServlet class, a servlet handling URL routing and URL generation for product and category pages within an e-commerce web application, specifically for the 'product' and 'category' URL paths.

classes.name: CatalogUrlServlet
classes.description: Servlet handling URL routing and URL creation for product and category pages in the web application.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests by delegating to doGet method.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Processes incoming GET requests, parses URL path info to determine product or category IDs, sets request attributes, and forwards to appropriate view.

methods.name: makeCatalogUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL for a product or category page based on request, current and previous category IDs.

methods.name: makeCatalogUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL for a product or category page based on context path, breadcrumb trail, and category/product IDs.
